macros.name: bcoordsys
macros.doc: The \bcoordsys command typesets boxed coordinate systems.

macros.name: coordgrid
macros.doc: The \coordgrid command typesets a coordinate grid.

macros.name: coordsys
macros.doc: Use the \coordsys command to typeset coordinate systems.

macros.name: fcoordsys
macros.doc: The \fcoordsys command typesets framed coordinate systems; that is, the axes are at the left and bottom edges of the system.

macros.name: gridstyle
macros.doc: The current \gridstyle applies to all types of grids: dotted, solid, regular, or logarithmic.

macros.name: interval
macros.doc: The \interval command takes as argument an interval in standard notation and draws it on the horizontal coordinate axis or number line.

macros.name: intervalthickness
macros.doc: The \intervalthickness command sets the thickness of the fat line that marks the interval.

macros.name: numbline
macros.doc: The \numbline command typesets a number line.

macros.name: vinterval
macros.doc: The \vinterval command similarly draws intervals on the vertical axis.

macros.name: window
macros.doc: The \window command typesets a plotting window as on a graphing calculator.
